mapper.select: SELECT * FROM afv_media_resource WHERE created_by = #{actor} AND request_id = #{requestId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM afv_media_resource WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT anchor_kind FROM afv_media_all_reference_document WHERE JSON_CONTAINS(JSON_EXTRACT(content,'$**.mediaId'),JSON_QUOTE(#{mediaId})) OR JSON_CONTAINS(JSON_EXTRACT(content,'$**.resourceId'),JSON_QUOTE(#{mediaId})) OR JSON_SEARCH(content,'one',CONCAT('%media://',#{mediaId},'%')) IS NOT NULL LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO afv_media_resource(id,project_id,owner_type,owner_id,created_by,actor_team_id,request_id,request_hash, media_kind,mime_type,original_name,byte_size,content_hash,width,height,duration_ms,has_audio,state,version, blob_id,ingest_epoch,origin,created_at,updated_at) SELECT #{id},#{projectId},#{ownerType},#{ownerId},#{actorUserId},#{actorTeamId},#{requestId},#{requestHash},media_kind,mime_type,original_name,byte_size,content_hash,width,height,duration_ms, has_audio,'READY',0,blob_id,1,'user',UTC_TIMESTAMP(6),UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) FROM afv_media_resource WHERE id=#{sourceId}
mapper.update: UPDATE afv_media_resource SET lease_until = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{id} AND state = 'STAGING'
UPDATE afv_media_resource SET state = 'READY', version = version + 1, lease_until = NULL, last_error = NULL, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{id} AND lease_until > UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)
UPDATE afv_media_resource SET state = 'FAILED', version = version + 1, lease_until = NULL, last_error = '媒体接收未完成，请重试', updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM afv_media_resource WHERE state = 'STAGING' AND lease_until <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) ORDER BY lease_until LIMIT 100 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO afv_media_resource(id, project_id, owner_type, owner_id, created_by, actor_team_id, request_id, request_hash, media_kind, mime_type, original_name, byte_size, content_hash, width, height, duration_ms, has_audio, state, blob_id, lease_until, origin, agent_run_id, tool_call_id, canvas_id) VALUES (#{resource.id}, #{resource.projectId}, #{resource.ownerType}, #{resource.ownerId}, #{resource.createdBy}, #{resource.actorTeamId}, #{resource.requestId}, #{resource.requestHash}, #{resource.mediaKind}, #{resource.mimeType}, #{resource.originalName}, #{resource.byteSize}, #{resource.contentHash}, #{resource.width}, #{resource.height}, #{resource.durationMs}, #{resource.hasAudio}, 'STAGING', #{resource.blobId}, TIMESTAMPADD(MINUTE, 10, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)), #{resource.origin}, #{resource.agentRunId}, #{resource.toolCallId}, #{resource.canvasId})
